name: DuckDuckGo Search
description: Search DuckDuckGo for web references to an attribute without an API key.
features: Searches the attribute value using the ddgs DuckDuckGo backend, without automatic provider fallback. Returns annotation objects containing result links, titles and snippets, related to the input attribute. max_results defaults to 5 (1-25); timeout defaults to 10 seconds (1-60) per search request. Blank settings use defaults. Searches use the library's us-en region and moderate safe search. This unofficial search integration can be rate-limited or broken by upstream changes. The attribute value is sent to DuckDuckGo; result pages are not downloaded. Search results are references for review, not maliciousness verdicts.
input: A URL, domain, hostname or text attribute.
output: Related annotation objects with search result links, titles and snippets; to_ids is false.

config.timeout: Optional integer 1-60 seconds per search request (default 10).

installation: Install the minimal/all extra, or pip install 'ddgs>=9.16.1,<10' in the misp-modules virtual environment. Restart the service and enable the duckduckgo_search expansion in MISP. Requires Python >=3.10; old Python 3.8 installations must upgrade.
limitations: Unofficial scraping integration: rate limiting, CAPTCHAs and upstream HTML changes can prevent results.
ddgs can report no results as DDGSException; the module reports this as a search error rather than claiming a confirmed empty result.
No automatic retries or fallback to another provider. DDGS_PROXY or HTTPS_PROXY/https_proxy can configure the proxy; SSL_CERT_FILE can configure CA trust.
timeout applies to individual library search requests; it is not a guaranteed wall-clock deadline for the full enrichment. Set the module-server and MISP enrichment timeouts accordingly.
